% ICD-007 downlink payloads - GENERATED by tools/schemagen, do not edit
% Source: bolt/wire/payloads.hpp + bolt/wire/types.hpp; regenerate via run-schemagen.sh
% Generated at 2026-07-27T20:47:47Z

The tables below mirror ICD-007: the per-type binary payload
definitions of protocol version 1 -- the wire ABI between flight
software and ground tooling. They are generated (2026-07-27T20:47:47Z) from the
\texttt{WIRE(...)}/\texttt{PACKET(...)} annotations in the flight
headers via C++26 reflection, so this appendix cannot drift from
the code.

\begin{itemize}
    \item Multi-byte fields are little-endian; payloads are packed, no padding.
    \item \emph{Gate} marks a field's validity source: \texttt{field:N} = valid
          only while bit N of \texttt{field} is set; a bare field name = valid only
          while that byte is non-zero; empty = always valid. Ground must not plot
          or act on a field whose gate is clear.
    \item The \emph{Type} column uses wire types (\texttt{u8}, \texttt{i16},
          \texttt{u16[18]} for arrays); enum fields show their underlying integer,
          with the value tables under Enumerations.
    \item Engineering value = raw $\cdot$ scale + offset. Unit \texttt{raw} needs
          a sensor-specific on-ground calculation (e.g.\ MS5611 uses D2 + PROM).
    \item Header 12 B + CRC16 2 B = 14 B frame overhead per packet. A rate of 0
          means event-driven.
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{Frame Format}

\begin{center}
    \texttt{[ header 12 B ][ payload 0..50 B ][ CRC16 2 B ]}\quad 64 B max
\end{center}

Sync bytes are \texttt{0xB0 0x17}; protocol version \texttt{1}.

\begin{table}[H]
    \centering\footnotesize
    \begin{tabular}{|l|l|r|r|}
        \hline
        \textbf{Field} & \textbf{Type} & \textbf{Off} & \textbf{Size} \\
        \hline
        \texttt{sync} & \texttt{u8[2]} & 0 & 2 \\
        \texttt{version} & \texttt{u8} & 2 & 1 \\
        \texttt{type} & \texttt{u8} & 3 & 1 \\
        \texttt{sequence} & \texttt{u8} & 4 & 1 \\
        \texttt{length} & \texttt{u8} & 5 & 1 \\
        \texttt{tick} & \texttt{u16} & 6 & 2 \\
        \texttt{timestamp\_us} & \texttt{u32} & 8 & 4 \\
        \hline
    \end{tabular}
    \caption{Downlink packet header (12 B)}
    \label{tab:icd7-header}
\end{table}

CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (polynomial \texttt{0x1021}, init \texttt{0xFFFF}) over every
byte after the two sync bytes -- the header from \texttt{version} onward plus the
payload -- stored \textbf{big-endian} in the trailing 2 B (the only big-endian
field in the frame).

\subsubsection{Enumerations}

Downlink field enums plus the uplink command set
(\texttt{CommandOpcode}/\texttt{CommandAckStatus}), so a value on the wire never
needs a look in the source. \textbf{(!)}\ marks a dangerous/irreversible command;
the ground UI gates these behind an arm + confirm step.

\paragraph{MissionMode (\texttt{u8})}
\begin{center}\footnotesize
    \begin{tabular}{|r|l|p{7.2cm}|}
        \hline
        \textbf{Value} & \textbf{Name} & \textbf{Description} \\
        \hline
        \texttt{0x00} & \texttt{TEST} & bench / pre-flight: experiments idle, test tick runs \\
        \texttt{0x01} & \texttt{FLIGHT} & LO seen: experiments run \\
        \hline
    \end{tabular}
\end{center}

\paragraph{GapReason (\texttt{u8})}
\begin{center}\footnotesize
    \begin{tabular}{|r|l|p{7.2cm}|}
        \hline

        \hline
        \texttt{0x01} & \texttt{NO\_DATA} & no valid CAN/source data inside the expected window \\
        \texttt{0x02} & \texttt{CAN\_CRC\_FAIL} & CAN frame received but failed CRC \\
        \texttt{0x03} & \texttt{LIFI\_TIMEOUT} & no sample packets from an EXP3 stack in the interval \\
        \texttt{0x04} & \texttt{SENSOR\_FAILED} & superseded by FAULT (ADR-012); wire-stable, no longer emitted \\
        \texttt{0x05} & \texttt{SELF\_TEST\_SKIPPED} & full-system self-test: the targeted node never reported and was skipped \\
        \hline

\end{center}
